Subject: Reminder: Client Confidentiality Policy

Hi Team,

I wanted to take a moment to remind everyone about the importance of maintaining strict confidentiality regarding our clients.

Recently, we learned that Bob shared specific client details with his wife. While I trust each of you individually, this action is a direct violation of our company’s confidentiality policy. It is critical that all client information remains strictly within professional boundaries and is not discussed with family members or anyone outside the authorized team.

Please ensure you are adhering to these guidelines at all times. If you have any questions about what constitutes sensitive information, please reach out to me or HR.

Thank you for your cooperation and professionalism.

Best regards,

[Your Name]
